scope: Read-only v6 localization source audit plus one parent-authorized fixed exploratory TFLite inference; no app/model/training/deployment changes or ADB.
conclusion: No missing crop origin or frame/upright rotation mismatch was established in the inspected source. Actual emulator misplaced-target cause remains unisolated.

checked_path.finding: Controls store native sensor corners. mapWordSensorBoxToFrame invokes native sensorToBuffer then applies mirror/quarter rotation with upright dimensions.
inferWordContext uses floor(start)/ceil(end) and stores the resulting global normalized context. Nitro crop expects start/end coordinates and makes Bitmap.createBitmap using end-start dimensions.
mapRoiBox adds actual.x/y after multiplying relative proposal x/y by actual width/height. detectWordImageCells applies it before grouping and before conversion to sensor points.

snapshotWordFrameBoxSensorPoints inverses the same mirror/rotation, multiplies by full upright dimensions and invokes native bufferToSensor. It does not interpret context-local output as a global box.

FrameConverter calls image.toBitmap(frame.orientation,frame.isMirrored). The extension mirrors then rotates once. Installed ImageProxy.toBitmap dispatches YUV to convertYUVToBitmap; bytecode allocates full image width/height and passes allplanes/strides, without applying a cropRect origin.

Each group and each cell uses native convertCameraPointToViewPoint divided by layout dp. The React view multiplies normalized coordinates back by the same layout. EMA changes display only; capture keeps the raw sensor group.

roundtrip.input: Injected synthetic dense output at a nonzero pixel-rounded crop; native pixels and affine methods mocked, no trained inference.

offset_check.finding: Observed approximately40 source-pixel vertical mismatch corresponds to approximately33 frame pixels under measured image scale. Neither dropping the full224px center-window origin nor dropping80px square-preview crop matches that offset. Actual adaptive window context was not logged, so this is a magnitude check, not an exclusion of every mapping fault.

exploratory_replay.model_and_thresholds: Exactly deployed baseline TFLite and current manifest thresholds, unchanged.
exploratory_replay.input: Full frozen1024feed inverse-sampled through measured source-to-preview affine into assumed upright480x640, fixed observed brightness gain/bias, bilinear rounding; center crop[0,224,480,416].
exploratory_replay.selected_group: Current TS grouping/center tracking selects the9-cell middle-row group at source approximately y105-153.
exploratory_replay.comparison: Did not reproduce actual11-green-box upper target. Input is an approximation, not real ImageAnalysis YUV pixels, and only the initial center window was replayed; no adaptive-window inference or tuning.

remaining_uncertainty: Actual ImageAnalysis frame pixels may differ from the preview-derived approximation through emulator sensor-stream mapping, YUV conversion/resampling, or native metadata.
Adaptive tracking context can change model proposals; only the observed screenshot and frozen shutter group were available, not the preceding context/output sequence.
Model localization can fail under camera preprocessing/scale; current evidence does not separate that from frame-pixel/native-coordinate disagreement.
minimum_next_discriminating_evidence: For the same frozen public feed, retain one actual upright frame or prepared crop, its pixel-rounded context, frame metadata/sensor points and raw proposal output from the same observation. Compare local proposals to the actual crop before mapping them into sensor/preview. This is a suggestion only; nothing was instrumented or captured in this audit.
limits: No physical-device or paper accuracy claim.
Numerical roundtrip with mocked native methods is not proof of actual frame pixels.
No additional training, weight promotion, threshold tuning or APK modification.
